description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates dynamic manipulation of a TableLayout, including toggling column stretchability and programmatically adding a row with TextViews.

classes.name: TableLayout8
classes.description: An Android activity class that manages a TableLayout and includes a toggle button to modify column stretch properties.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up UI interaction for toggling column stretchability.

methods.name: appendRow
methods.description: Dynamically creates a TableRow with two TextViews and adds it to the TableLayout.
